faqs.question: How many modules can fit on a standard room switchboard?

faqs.question: How do you pull new wires through walls without damaging paint or plaster?
faqs.answer: We utilize existing concealed PVC conduit pipes embedded inside your walls. By attaching new cables to steel fish tape or the old wires, we draw them through cleanly without wall breaking.

faqs.question: What is FRLS wire and why is it important?
faqs.answer: FRLS stands for Flame Retardant Low Smoke. In the event of an electrical short circuit, FRLS insulation resists catching fire and emits minimal toxic smoke, protecting home occupants.

faqs.question: Why did my concealed wires get damaged inside the wall?
faqs.answer: Common reasons include continuous electrical overloading that melts insulation, moisture leaking from plumbing pipes into electrical conduits, or rats chewing through conduit wiring.

faqs.question: Can aluminum wiring be connected directly to copper wiring?
faqs.answer: Directly twisting copper and aluminum wires causes galvanic corrosion and fire hazards. If transitioning between metals, specialized bi-metallic connector lugs must be used.

faqs.question: Why does my bathroom floor drain emit a bad sewer smell?
faqs.answer: Sewer smell occurs when the water trap beneath the drain dries out or when hair and soap scum decompose inside the pipe. Our service cleans the trap and restores the protective water seal.

faqs.question: Will using a motorized drain snake damage my PVC drainage pipes?
faqs.answer: No. Our technicians use professional plumbing snakes with flexible bulb augers and smooth torque control designed specifically to navigate PVC bends without puncturing pipe walls.

faqs.question: Can pouring acid into the drain fix a stubborn blockage?
faqs.answer: Acid creates intense exothermic heat that can warp thin PVC pipes, dissolve rubber gasket seals, and damage chrome fittings. Mechanical auger clearing is far safer and more effective.

faqs.question: How long does a drainage unblocking and repair service take?

faqs.question: What is the difference between CPVC and UPVC pipes?
faqs.answer: UPVC pipes are suitable only for cold water supply. CPVC (Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride) is specially treated to withstand hot water temperatures up to 93°C, making it ideal for geysers and hot water lines.

faqs.question: Why do you use brass-threaded fittings at tap connection points?
faqs.answer: Metal taps threaded into pure plastic threads can easily cross-thread or crack the fitting under wrench pressure. Brass-insert fittings provide indestructible, leak-proof metal-to-metal threading.

faqs.question: Why did my plastic CPVC pipe crack spontaneously?
faqs.answer: Cracks typically result from excessive water hammer pressure spikes, poor original solvent bonding, overtightened metal fittings, or exposure to freezing or high heat without thermal expansion loops.

faqs.question: Can you use epoxy putty (M-Seal) to fix a leaking pressurized water pipe?
faqs.answer: Epoxy putty cannot withstand 2-4 Bar of continuous water line pressure and will blow out within days. We cut out the damaged section and install permanent solvent-welded repair unions.

faqs.question: Why is a bottle trap better than a simple flexible accordion drain pipe?
faqs.answer: Rigid bottle traps feature an internal water seal that permanently blocks noxious sewer gases and cockroaches from entering your home, and have a detachable cup for cleaning lost jewelry or clogs.

faqs.question: How do you find a pipe leak inside a wall without breaking the tiles?
faqs.answer: We utilize advanced non-destructive diagnostic tools including thermal infrared cameras that detect temperature changes and acoustic leak detectors that amplify the microscopic sound of pressurized water spraying inside the wall.

faqs.question: Can you tell if dampness is caused by a leaking pipe or bathroom floor waterproofing failure?
faqs.answer: Yes. A pressurized pipe leak causes continuous 24/7 moisture and shows pressure loss on our hydrostatic test gauge. Waterproofing leakage only occurs during active bathroom usage.

faqs.question: Why is my neighbor downstairs complaining of ceiling dampness when my bathroom floor looks dry?
faqs.answer: Water from a concealed pipe leak or cracked floor trap penetrates beneath floor tiles and travels along the waterproof membrane until finding a crack in the RCC slab, dripping onto the ceiling below.

faqs.question: Does this detection service include fixing the broken pipe once found?
faqs.answer: The service fee covers complete high-tech non-destructive detection. Once the exact tile location is marked, our technician can perform the surgical pipe repair under our standard pipe repair service.

faqs.question: Why is an air vent pipe necessary on an overhead water tank delivery line?
faqs.answer: The air vent pipe allows air into the delivery pipe, preventing vacuum locks that cause weak water pressure and sputtering taps throughout your home.

faqs.question: Why must a water tank sit on a completely flat, solid base?
faqs.answer: A 1000-liter water tank weighs over 1000 kg (1 ton) when full. If the base has uneven gaps or sharp points, the immense hydrostatic pressure will crack the plastic tank bottom.

faqs.question: What is the purpose of a union fitting on the tank outlet pipe?
faqs.answer: A disconnect union fitting allows the tank to be disconnected and moved for rooftop waterproofing or replacement in the future without cutting the PVC pipes.

faqs.question: Does this service include connecting the overflow pipe?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install the overflow line with a mosquito-proof wire mesh and route it to an easily visible drain point so you know when the tank is full.
